newsitem.title: UK: Amersham, PE in cross-license deal.
newsitem.headline: Amersham, PE in cross-license deal.

text.p: British-based health science company Amersham International said on Tuesday that its life science division, PE Applied Biosystems, a unit of Perkin Elmer Corp, and Roche Molecular Systems Inc had agreed reciprocal cross-licence deals in technology supporting DNA sequencing.
In a statement, the company said the arrangements would be royalty-bearing and would "spearhead developments in the growing market of high throughput DNA sequencing".

"Amersham's intellectual property base in DNA sequencing has been extended and will enable researchers to use kits and systems which provide real improvements in high-throughput DNA sequencing," it quoted Ron Long, divisional managing director as saying.
"Furthermore, it ensures that Amersham continues to concentrate its research resources into producing more novel sequencing products," he added.
